transformed_arr = test_arr.copy()

    row_sixes = sorted([c for c in range(cols) if test_arr[r,c] == 6])
    if len(row_sixes) > 0:
        i = 0
        while i < len(row_sixes):
            j = i
            while j + 1 < len(row_sixes) and row_sixes[j+1] == row_sixes[j] + 1:
                j += 1
            
            run_start = row_sixes[i]
            run_end = row_sixes[j]
            run_width = run_end - run_start + 1
            
            if run_width >= 8:
                mid = run_start + run_width // 2
                for c in range(run_start, mid):
                    transformed_arr[r,c] = 2
                for c in range(mid, run_end + 1):
                    transformed_arr[r,c] = 8
            else:
                for c in range(run_start, run_end + 1):

            i = j + 1
